metadata.question: Does the water surface area of Lake Tuz in Turkey decrease in August 2016 compared to August 1988?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about changes in water surface area of Lake Tuz in Turkey between August 1988 and August 2016. This requires: 1. Data Strategy: - Use Landsat 5 for 1988 (Landsat 8 wasn't available then) - Use Landsat 8 for 2016 - Focus on August for both years - Calculate water area using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) 2. Processing: - Define Lake Tuz geometry - Calculate NDWI for both time periods - Apply water threshold (NDWI > 0 typically indicates water) - Calculate pixel counts and convert to area 3. Validation: - Check if collections have images - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Ensure calculations are valid Let me structure this: - Get Landsat 5 for 1988 August - Get Landsat 8 for 2016 August - Calculate NDWI and water masks - Compare water areas - Handle missing data cases ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeTuz = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [33.0, 38.7], [33.8, 38.7], [33.8, 39.1], [33.0, 39.1], [33.0, 38.7] ]); const aug1988 = ee.DateRange('1988-08-01', '1988-08-31'); const aug2016 = ee.DateRange('2016-08-01', '2016-08-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1988, Landsat 8 for 2016 let col1988 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C01/T1_SR') .filterBounds(lakeTuz) .filterDate(aug1988) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); let col2016 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_SR') .filterBounds(lakeTuz) .filterDate(aug2016) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); // Check collection sizes const size1988 = col1988.size().getInfo(); const size2016 = col2016.size().getInfo(); print(`1988 Images: ${size1988}, 2016 Images: ${size2016}`); if (size1988 === 0 || size2016 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get median composites and calculate water area const composite1988 = col1988.median(); const composite2016 = col2016.median(); // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi1988 = composite1988.normalizedDifference(['B2', 'B4']).rename('NDWI'); const ndwi2016 = composite2016.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B5']).rename('NDWI'); // Create water masks (NDWI > 0.0 indicates water) const water1988 = ndwi1988.gt(0.0); const water2016 = ndwi2016.gt(0.0); // Calculate water pixel counts const waterCount1988 = water1988.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeTuz, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const waterCount2016 = water2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeTuz, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); // Convert to area in square kilometers const pixelArea = 0.0009; // 30m x 30m = 900 sq m = 0.0009 sq km const area1988 = waterCount1988 * pixelArea; const area2016 = waterCount2016 * pixelArea; print(`1988 Water Area: ${area1988.toFixed(2)} sq km`); print(`2016 Water Area: ${area2016.toFixed(2)} sq km`); print(`Change: ${(area2016 - area1988).toFixed(2)} sq km`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (waterCount1988 === 0 || waterCount2016 === 0) { print("C2"); } else if (area1988 === null || area2016 === null || !isFinite(area1988) || !isFinite(area2016)) { print("C3"); } else if (area2016 < area1988) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } catch (error) { print(`Error: ${error}`); print("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
